name: nonApi_logPortalRequest
description: Inserts a portal request audit entry into LOG.GeneralLog. Called by PortalApiHC6 after every successful HC6 portal SP dispatch. Fire-and-forget — errors are swallowed by the caller.

parameters.name: logSource
parameters.description: Short source label identifying the SP dispatched, e.g. 'Admin Portal: hcportal_getEvents'. Caller truncates to 50 characters before calling. Table column is NVARCHAR(50) NOT NULL — matches parameter type exactly.

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: IP address or request identifier for audit purposes. Table column is NVARCHAR(255) NOT NULL — matches parameter type exactly.

sideEffects: Inserts 1 row into LOG.GeneralLog with LogSource, Message, and Timestamp = SYSUTCDATETIME().
LOG.GeneralLog.Timestamp has a DEFAULT of GETDATE() but the SP passes SYSUTCDATETIME() explicitly — ensures UTC timestamp regardless of server local time setting.
breakingChanges: HC5 used inline SQL in PortalApiHC6.LogRequestAsync. HC6 extracts this into a named SP.
